label_definitions.false_abstention: The evidence was retrieved and the model declined to answer. Pure generation defect, and the cheapest class to fix.
label_definitions.incomplete_list: Covered some but not all gold items it had evidence for. The single largest generation defect on list-valued questions.

label_definitions.unsupported_items: Asserted items the retrieved evidence does not contain -- invention rather than omission. Precision defect.
